summary: Arbitration jurisdiction challenge; consent to sole arbitrator recorded on 5.12.2003; statement of defence filed 14.02.2004; objection to tribunal composition raised belatedly on 24.04.2004; bar under Arbitration Act s.16(2); jurisdiction plea invalid post-defence submission; conduct estops challenge; setting aside award on composition grounds erroneous; challenge to jurisdiction time-barred.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgments setting aside award reversed; award upheld; costs awarded to appellant.
